#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create an ICS calendar entry for the Project Kickoff Meeting on the
next Monday from today, 10:00-12:00, with a 15-minute reminder."""

import time
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo, ZoneInfoNotFoundError

OUT_PATH = Path("project_kickoff.ics")

# ---- Resolve a usable local timezone (fallback to US Eastern) ----
tz_name = None
for candidate in (time.tzname[0], time.tzname[1]):
    if not candidate:
        continue
    try:
        ZoneInfo(candidate)
        tz_name = candidate
        break
    except (ZoneInfoNotFoundError, ValueError):
        continue
if tz_name is None:
    tz_name = "America/New_York"
tz = ZoneInfo(tz_name)

# ---- Compute next Monday (strictly after today) ----
now = datetime.now(tz)
days_until_monday = (7 - now.weekday()) % 7
if days_until_monday == 0:
    days_until_monday = 7
monday = (now + timedelta(days=days_until_monday)).date()
start = datetime(monday.year, monday.month, monday.day, 10, 0, 0, tzinfo=tz)
end = start + timedelta(hours=2)

summary = "Project Kickoff Meeting"
description = "Kickoff meeting for the new project. Agenda: goals, timeline, roles and responsibilities, and next steps."
uid = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@project-kickoff"

# ---- Try the icalendar library first; fall back to manual RFC 5545 ----
try:
    from icalendar import Alarm, Calendar, Event

    cal = Calendar()
    cal.add("prodid", "-//Project Kickoff//Calendar Skill//EN")
    cal.add("version", "2.0")
    cal.add("calscale", "GREGORIAN")

    event = Event()
    event.add("summary", summary)
    event.add("description", description)
    event.add("dtstart", start)
    event.add("dtend", end)
    event.add("dtstamp", now)
    event.add("uid", uid)
    event.add("status", "CONFIRMED")
    event.add("sequence", 0)
    event.add("transp", "OPAQUE")

    alarm = Alarm()
    alarm.add("action", "DISPLAY")
    alarm.add("description", "Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes")
    alarm.add("trigger", timedelta(minutes=-15))
    event.add_component(alarm)

    cal.add_component(event)
    data = cal.to_ical()
    library_used = True
except ImportError:
    library_used = False
    lines = [
        "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
        "VERSION:2.0",
        "PRODID:-//Project Kickoff//Calendar Skill//EN",
        "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
        "BEGIN:VEVENT",
        f"UID:{uid}",
        f"DTSTAMP:{now.astimezone(ZoneInfo('UTC')).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}",
        f"DTSTART;TZID={tz_name}:{start.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}",
        f"DTEND;TZID={tz_name}:{end.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')}",
        f"SUMMARY:{summary}",
        f"DESCRIPTION:{description.replace(chr(10), chr(92) + 'n')}",
        "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
        "SEQUENCE:0",
        "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
        "BEGIN:VALARM",
        "ACTION:DISPLAY",
        "DESCRIPTION:Project Kickoff Meeting starts in 15 minutes",
        "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
        "END:VALARM",
        "END:VEVENT",
        "END:VCALENDAR",
        "",
    ]
    data = "\r\n".join(lines).encode("utf-8")

OUT_PATH.write_bytes(data)

# ---- Validate by parsing back ----
try:
    from icalendar import Calendar as ParseCal

    parsed = ParseCal.from_ical(OUT_PATH.read_bytes())
    parsed_events = [c for c in parsed.walk() if c.name == "VEVENT"]
    assert len(parsed_events) == 1, "Expected exactly one VEVENT"
    validation = "OK (parsed with icalendar)"
except ImportError:
    text = OUT_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert text.count("BEGIN:VEVENT") == 1 and text.count("END:VEVENT") == 1
    assert "BEGIN:VCALENDAR" in text and "END:VCALENDAR" in text
    assert "UID:" in text and "DTSTAMP:" in text
    validation = "OK (manual structural check)"

print(f"Created: {OUT_PATH}")
print(f"Library used: {library_used}")
print(f"Event: {summary}")
print(f"Date: {monday.isoformat()} (next Monday)")
print(f"Start: {start.isoformat()}")
print(f"End: {end.isoformat()}")
print(f"Timezone: {tz_name}")
print(f"Reminder: 15 minutes before")
print(f"Validation: {validation}")
